headlines.title: Marriott International (MAR) Adds Eight Hotels In The Netherlands
headlines.summary: Marriott International (NasdaqGS:MAR) agreed a deal to add eight hotels to its portfolio in the Netherlands. The expansion includes the launch of the Series hotel brand in the Dutch market for the first time. Marriott opened JW Marriott's first all-inclusive resort in Costa Rica, marking a new format for the luxury flag. The Dutch eight hotel expansion and JW Marriott all inclusive launch in Costa Rica sit within a wider Marriott story.

headlines.title: Marriott expands Dutch footprint with eight-hotel deal
headlines.summary: Six hotels will join Series by Marriott in the Netherlands, while two will enter its Tribute portfolio.

headlines.title: THE RISE OF PLACE: MARRIOTT INTERNATIONAL REVEALS ASIA PACIFIC'S FUTURE OF FOOD
headlines.summary: Marriott International has unveiled Future of Food 2027, its latest report exploring food and beverage trends across Asia Pacific excluding China. Drawing on conversations with leading chefs, hospitality experts and regional influencers, alongside insights from Marriott International properties across the region, the report reveals a pivotal transformation: the rise of place.

headlines.title: Hilton and Marriott hotel operator files Chapter 11 bankruptcy
headlines.summary: An SEC settlement and a new lawsuit involving $86 million and thousands of investors add another twist to the bankruptcy.

headlines.title: 1 Large-Cap Stock Worth Your Attention and 2 We Find Risky
headlines.summary: Large-cap stocks are known for their staying power and ability to weather market storms better than smaller competitors. However, their sheer size makes it more challenging to maintain high growth rates as they’ve already captured significant portions of their markets.

description: Marriott International, Inc. engages in the operation, franchising, and licensing of hotel, residential, timeshare, and other lodging properties in the United States, Canada, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Greater China, the Asia-Pacific, and internationally. The company operates properties under the JW Marriott, The Ritz-Carlton, The Luxury Collection, W Hotels, St. Regis, EDITION, Bvlgari, Marriott Hotels, Sheraton, Westin, Autograph Collection, Renaissance Hotels, Le Méridien, Delta Hotels by Marriott, MGM Collection with Marriott Bonvoy, Tribute Portfolio, Gaylord Hotels, Design Hotels, Marriott Executive Apartments, Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy, Courtyard by Marriott, Fairfield by Marriott, Residence Inn by Marriott, SpringHill Suites by Marriott, Four Points by Sheraton, TownePlace Suites by Marriott, Aloft Hotels, AC Hotels by Marriott, Moxy Hotels, Element Hotels, Protea Hotels by Marriott, citizenM, City Express by Marriott, and Four Points Flex by Sheraton brands. It also operates residences, timeshares, and yachts. The company was formerly known as New Marriott MI, Inc. and changed its name to Marriott International, Inc. in May 1998. Marriott International, Inc. was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland.
